title: Choose the visual world for the Real Estate Call CRM
question: The roll assigned Surveyor's Field Transit Ledger (with 2 challengers in the re-roll pool: variable-font-specimen, emigre-bitmap-specimen). Keep it, pick an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Surveyor's Field Transit Ledger
options.lineage: Weatherproof buff surveyor field notebooks & brass transit logs
options.thesis: An outdoor-grade real estate field notebook engineered for sunlight legibility and one-thumb call logging between showings.
materials: stamped survey ink & brass rule lines
options.viewport: Mobile-first field cockpit: sticky red-flagged Overdue Follow-ups strip at top, live phone/duplicate search bar, and ruled lead dossier rows with huge one-tap Call, WhatsApp, and <10s Log Call controls.
options.risk: Can feel overly rugged if spacing and tabular phone numerals are not kept razor-sharp.

raised.raise: State is a mark in a fixed cell: vermilion strikes overdue and no-answer calls, bottle green confirms answered and viewing-scheduled leads, and the active lead reverses onto a dark slate plate.
Every grid rule, timeline detent, and call-to-follow-up bracket is drawn at 1px precision with zero ornamental radius.

options.label: Brokerage Deal-Desk Call Sheet
options.lineage: Brokerage daily call sheets, red-tabbed index cards & MLS tear-sheets
options.thesis: The classic high-velocity brokerage call sheet where every lead is an indexed card with a stamped call timeline and red grease-pencil overdue tabs.
materials: red urgency tabs & tabular typewriter numerals
options.viewport: Split mobile/desk call ledger: Today's Follow-up queue pinned at top with red overdue badges, instant phone/duplicate checker, and a 3-tap inline Log Call drawer.
options.risk: The most familiar grounded direction for a real estate call desk.

options.label: Jet-Age Coupon Dossier
options.lineage: 1960s airline ticket wallets, carbon-copy coupons & route tags
options.thesis: Every lead and call follow-up is a perforated carbon-copy coupon stub in carrier navy and red over crisp coupon stock.
options.viewport: Stacked coupon book of Today's Follow-ups where logging a call stamps the coupon and tears off to advance the next callback.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: fixed fare/flight boxes map naturally to budget, property type, phone numerals, and stamped call outcomes.
options.risk: Reads like travel ephemera if real estate property fields and phone actions are not foregrounded.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding Dispatch
options.lineage: International airport overhead yellow signage & split-flap gate boards
options.thesis: High-contrast Schiphol-yellow wayfinding bands and monumental phone numerals built for zero-squint mobile dialing on the move.
options.viewport: Overhead yellow wayfinding band showing 'TODAY'S FOLLOW-UPS · 3 OVERDUE', monumental lead rows below, and black inset pictogram buttons for Call, WhatsApp, and Log Call.
options.case: Unbeatable mobile glanceability for an agent walking between property showings.
options.risk: Saturated yellow across long desk sessions can feel intense if not balanced with crisp white/black data rows.

options.label: Pocket Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1971 pocket airline timetable on a lit goldenrod bed
options.thesis: Single-type-size schedule rack where rank is carried strictly by weight, case, reversal, and vermilion/green cell marks.
materials: slate tinted glass & opaque ivory panes
options.viewport: Continuous schedule rack of callback slots with one reversed active lead plate.
options.case: 11-degree raked parallelogram containers fight one-handed mobile phone ergonomics.
options.kept: Fixed-cell vermilion/bottle-green state marks and an opaque reversed plate for the active lead.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.lineage: Wide-margin reference editions with a vermilion centre key rail
options.thesis: Two short-measure columns twinned around a 1px vermilion centre rail of call-history keys on unbleached bone.
options.viewport: Twinned lead-spec and call-history columns joined by a centre vermilion key rail.
options.case: Wide four-inch literary margins waste precious mobile viewport width during live calls.
options.kept: 1px precision ruling engine with zero border-radius and square timeline detents.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean modern mobile-first SaaS CRM executed with crisp typography, high-contrast status pills, and red overdue badges.
materials: tactile status pills & mobile action bar
canonCard.viewport: Sticky search and Today's Follow-ups toggle at top, structured lead cards with instant Call/WhatsApp/Log Call buttons, and slide-up 10-second call logger.
canonCard.risk: Familiar modern CRM look, indistinguishable from top commercial tools by design.
